newsitem.title: USA: Committee backs William Daley for US Commerce post.
newsitem.headline: Committee backs William Daley for US Commerce post.

text.p: The Senate Commerce Committee Wednesday approved the nomination of William Daley to be secretary of the Commerce Department by a vote of 15-1.
Daley's nomination now goes to the full Senate. A vote could come later Wednesday or Thursday.

The only vote against Daley came from Sen. Sam Brownback, R-Kansas, who said he did not believe Daley was committed enough to changing the department and removing political influence. Daley, a Chicago lawyer, promised last week to take politics out of the department and eliminate 100 political appointees. He would replace Mickey Kantor.
